Package domain

Class StatusEffect

java.lang.Object
domain.StatusEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConfusionEffect, ElectrocutedEffect, PushEffect, UnconsciousEffect
public abstract class StatusEffect extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a temporary status effect applied to a player by a power shot
